營收走勢圖

玻璃陶瓷–電子材料  
富喬(1815.TT) 
AI 材料升級趨勢確立，高階玻纖布開啟成長新局

富喬為台灣少數具備紗、布垂直整合與自有配方能力的玻纖布廠。2H26 
受惠二代低介電布放量、報價調漲及良率改善，營收與 獲利可望逐季創
高；進入 2027 年後，獲利成長動能將由高階產品占比提升與新增產能
貢獻。台灣廠持續將既有產能轉向二代低介電布，東莞廠自 1Q27 起分
批將 E 布產能升級至二代布，泰國一期則自 2H27 起逐步投產，承接
客戶對非中國高階產能的需求，加上低膨脹布開始導入，產品組合將進
一步往高階化發展。研究部預估富喬 2026、2027 年稅後 EPS 分別為 
5.13 元與 9.30 元，稅後淨利分別年增 267.9% 與 81.4%。考量富喬
為日系龍頭以外少數具備垂直整合與自有配方能力的供應商，以  2027 
年獲利為評價基礎，給予 20 倍本益比，目標價 185 元，初次給予買進
投資評等。

1. 規格升級推動產品組合高階化 
AI 伺服器與高速交換器的傳輸速率持續提升 ， 板材由 M7、M8 向 M9 以
上升級，玻纖布同步由 E-glass 轉向一代、二代低介電布。石英布因鑽
孔與除膠渣良率受限而導入遞延，終端客戶轉回採用二代低介電布，延
長其產品週期。研究部預估富喬二代低介電布營收占比將由 2025 年的 
7%，提升至 2026 年的 27% 與 2027 年的 51%。

2. 既有機台重新配置，毛利率大幅跳升 
玻纖布織布機由豐田獨家供應 ， 新機交期已排至 2031 年，2027 年以前
產業新增供給主要仰賴既有機台重新配置 。 富喬現有約 920 台織機 ， 憑
藉紗、布垂直整合，可在無須大幅增加資本支出下將既有產能轉向二代
低介電布 ， 帶動毛利率由 2025 年的 27.6%， 升至 2026 年的 44.7% 與 
2027 年的 54.8%。

### Page 2

請參見末頁重要披露及免責聲明 2

公司簡介 
富喬工業（1815 TT）成立於 1999 年，為台灣少數具備玻璃纖維紗至玻璃纖
維布垂直整合能力的材料廠，主要產品涵蓋電子級、工業級玻纖紗及電子級玻
纖布，其中電子級玻纖布為銅箔基板（CCL）與印刷電路板（PCB）的關鍵上游
材料。公司目前主要生產基地位於雲林斗六、虎尾及中國東莞，並已布局泰國
新產能，以強化非中國供應鏈配置。相較單純織布廠，富喬具備自有玻纖紗生
產與配方研發能力，可依終端規格變化調整紗種與產品組合。近年受惠 AI 伺
服器、高速交換器等應用帶動 PCB 材料規格持續升級，富喬營運重心逐步由
傳統 E-glass 轉向低介電等高階電子級材料。

玻纖布產業介紹 
玻纖布位於 PCB 材料供應鏈最上游，製程橫跨玻璃熔煉與紡織兩個領域。玻
纖原料經窯爐熔融後 ， 由鉑銠漏板拉製成單絲 ， 再經上漿 、 集束與加撚形成電
子紗 ， 後續以織機織成玻纖布 ， 並經開纖及矽烷偶聯劑等後處理後 ， 交由 CCL 
廠含浸樹脂製成膠片，再與銅箔壓合成銅箔基板，最終應用於 PCB 或載板。 
玻纖布規格主要可由織物型號 、 紗徑與玻璃配方三個面向區分 。 以織物型號而
言，7628 屬厚布，基重約 210 g/m²，2116、1080 依序變薄，10 系列則屬超
薄布；若依紗徑區分，粗紗單纖直徑約 9 至 13 微米，細紗則降至約 4 至 
9 微米，隨紗徑變細，斷絲風險與製程難度同步提高，織機亦須降速，超薄布
生產效率僅約厚布的二分之一至三分之一 。 另一方面 ， 玻璃配方則直接決定材
料電性 ， 介電損耗亦隨材料世代持續下降 。 隨高速傳輸規格提升 ，玻纖與樹脂
之間的介電差異會放大訊號時延與織紋效應 ， 因此傳輸速率每提升一個世代 ，
材料亦須同步升級。 
除玻璃配方外，織布後的開纖與表面處理亦是高階玻纖布性能的關鍵。即使
CCL 廠商採用相同原料，不同玻纖布廠的產品在電性、耐熱性與良率上的表現
仍可能存在顯著差異，也使高階玻纖布認證週期通常長達兩年以上。就材料成
本結構而言，玻纖布占傳統 CCL 材料成本約 25% 至 40%，若升級至石英布，
占比可提高至約六成；隨高階 PCB 對 CCL 規格與用量提升，CCL 占 PCB 用
料成本比重亦由過去三至四成提升至五成以上。玻纖布因此已由過去的通用材
料，逐步轉變為影響高速板材性能、成本與供應穩定性的關鍵材料。

富喬為台灣少數具備玻纖紗、布
垂直整合與自有配方能力的材料
廠，近年受惠 AI 帶動高階 PCB 
材料升級 ， 營運重心正由傳統 E-
glass 轉向低介電玻纖布，並同
步布局泰國非中國產能。

玻纖布位於 PCB 材料供應鏈最
上游 ， 製程與認證門檻高 ， 且隨高
速傳輸推升材料規格升級，其成
本占比與對板材性能的重要性同
步提升，已由通用材料轉為高階  
PCB 的關鍵材料。

請參見末頁重要披露及免責聲明 4

AI 世代推升高速材料規格持續升級 
AI 基礎建設對材料的需求，並非僅來自伺服器出貨量成長，更重要的是運算
密度與傳輸速率持續提升，帶動 PCB 材料規格同步升級。相較傳統伺服器約
三至四年的平台週期，AI 伺服器迭代速度明顯加快，GPU、ASIC 與交換器間
的資料傳輸需求快速增加，推動網路架構由 400G、800G 向 1.6T、3.2T 演
進。隨訊號速率提升，傳輸損耗與訊號完整性要求同步提高，板材須持續降低
介電常數與介電損耗，帶動 CCL 由 M7、M8 向 M9 以上升級；玻纖布作為影
響板材電性的重要材料，亦由傳統 E-glass 逐步升級至一代、二代低介電
布，並進一步朝石英布與第三代低介電材料發展。 
就目前材料演進路徑而言，400G 交換器主要採用 M7 板材搭配一代低介電
布，800G 升級至 M8 後，一代與二代低介電布開始並用；進入 1.6T 世代
後，二代低介電布的重要性進一步提升，部分高階規格則開始評估導入石英
布。展望 2028 年後，隨 3.2T 逐步導入，材料規格預期將進一步朝升級版石
英布或第三代低介電布發展，高階玻纖布的滲透率持續提升。 
研究部認為，規格升級將成為本輪玻纖布產業成長的核心驅動力。隨 AI 運算
與高速傳輸規格持續演進，材料需求將由傳統 E-glass 加速轉向低介電、低
膨脹等高階產品。在終端平台持續更替的背景下，玻纖布須隨板材世代同步升
級，而每一次規格提升亦伴隨 ASP 與單位產值增加，使產業成長不僅來自需
求量擴張，更來自產品組合持續高階化。

### Page 5

請參見末頁重要披露及免責聲明 5

專利與認證構成高階玻纖布的實質進入障礙 
高階玻纖布的核心技術門檻在玻纖紗配方，低介電與低膨脹材料的關鍵專利亦
主要集中於紗端，後進者若要切入，須重新設計配方以迴避既有專利，良率與
量產時程因而受限。另一方面，CCL 廠需將特定玻纖布與樹脂、銅箔共同調
校，一旦納入合格供應商名單，更換材料通常須重新開立料號並進行完整驗
證，使認證週期可長達數年。富喬憑藉紗、布垂直整合，可直接由紗端調整配
方與製程，並已完成多地高階低介電玻纖布專利布局，低膨脹布亦已突破既有
專利限制並通過終端認證。研究部認為專利保護與長認證週期共同構成高階玻
纖布的實質進入障礙，亦使中國廠商產能雖快速擴張，短期內能實際轉化為高
階產品供給的比例仍有限。

供需失衡與料源綁定 
玻纖布供需失衡自 2026 年起由通用布延伸至高階布，主要瓶頸集中於織機、
良率與認證。玻纖布織機由豐田獨家供應，新機交期已排至 2031 年，且超薄
與特殊布須降速生產，使名目機台數無法等比轉化為實際產出；另一方面，高
階布認證週期普遍超過兩年，也使既有產能難以在短期內快速切換料號。 
E 布短缺主要來自龍頭廠商退出低階產能。日東紡、旭化成陸續停產 E-glass 
布後，供給收縮帶動各類 E 布報價自 2025 年底至 2026 年普遍上漲逾一倍
以上。惟中國新增產能自 2027 年陸續開出，加上消費性需求仍偏弱，研究部
預期 E 布供需將於 2027 年逐步緩解，報價漲幅趨緩。 
一代低介電布供需相對平衡，惟隨二代布需求放大，具備雙線能力的廠商傾向
將織機轉向二代布。二代低介電布則為目前供給最為吃緊的品項，主要對應 
M8 以上板材。除織機供給受限外，良率更是限制有效產出的關鍵，新進者量
產良率多不足五成，使名目產能與實際出貨量存在明顯落差，也支撐二代布報
價維持在一代布的約 2 至 3 倍。 
低膨脹布的供給缺口則可能延續更久。隨先進封裝尺寸放大與層數增加，而供
應仍高度集中於日東紡，新產能最快自 2H27 起陸續開出。石英布則面臨不同
瓶頸，問題不在供給，而在加工良率與導入進度；由於鑽孔與除膠渣難度較
高，部分原規劃採用石英布的設計轉回二代低介電布，反而延長二代布的產品
週期。 
供給吃緊亦同步改變材料認證與採購模式。過去玻纖布多由 CCL 廠與板廠選
料，現階段雲端業者與系統廠已逐步直接認證布廠並指定料源，部分客戶另要
求非中國產能，CCL 廠亦透過長約提前鎖定高階布供給。高階玻纖布的競爭因
而由單純產能擴張，轉向認證、良率與料源掌握能力的競爭。

高階玻纖布具備配方專利與長認
證週期雙重門檻，限制新進者有
效產能釋放，也使富喬憑藉紗布
垂直整合與既有認證基礎建立明
顯競爭優勢。

玻纖布供給受限於織機、良率與
認證門檻，高階產品短缺延續並
推動客戶直接綁定料源，產業競
爭 重 心 由 產 能 擴 張 轉 向 認 證 能
力、量產良率與供應穩定性。

圖三、二代低介電布供需缺口

資料來源：統一投顧預估

產能配置與產品組合 
富喬目前共有約 920 台織布機，其中台灣 490 台、東莞 430 台。受限於織
布機交期，富喬 2027 年以前的主要成長動能，是將既有機台由 E 布、一代
低介電布持續轉向單位產值與毛利率更高的二代低介電布，透過產品組合升級
放大既有產能效益。 
台灣廠部分機台維持生產 E 布，供應台系 CCL 廠與低軌衛星應用，其餘產能
則持續轉向二代低介電布，低膨脹布亦預計自 2027 年起逐步導入。海外方
面，東莞現有 430 台於 2026 年仍以 E 布為主，自 1Q27 起採台灣供紗、當
地織布模式分批轉作二代低介電布。泰國一期則規劃新增 500 台織機，預計
自 2H27 起分批到位，主要生產低介電布並承接客戶對非中國產能的需求。 
富喬能快速進行跨廠區與跨產品配置，關鍵在於紗、布垂直整合。公司自有電
子級玻纖紗可隨布種升級同步調整紗的配方與規格，降低對外部紗源的依賴。
隨台灣產能持續高階化、東莞轉產二代布及泰國新產能加入，研究部預估二代
低介電布營收占比將由 2025 年的 7%，提升至 2026 年的 27% 與 2027 年的 
51%，同期毛利率亦由 27.6% 升至 44.7% 與 54.8%。

富喬以既有機台轉產高毛利二代
低介電布，並透過東莞轉線與泰
國新產能擴充高階產品供給，帶
動二代布營收占比與整體毛利率
持續提升。

### Page 7

請參見末頁重要披露及免責聲明 7

圖四、富喬產品組合演變（營收占比）

資料來源：統一投顧預估

營運概況 
1. 2H26 營運將改寫新高 
富喬 7、8 月營收分別為 8.54 億元（+24.0% MoM、+68.1% YoY）與 9.12 億
元（+6.8% MoM、+79.2% YoY） ，連續改寫單月新高。隨新一代 AI 伺服器與 
1.6T 交換器平台陸續放量，二代低介電布需求同步攀升，加以 6 月起調漲的
報價自 3Q26 全季認列，研究部預估 3Q26 營收 27.66 億元（+29.8% QoQ、
+80.4% YoY） ，改寫單季歷史新高。毛利率升至 48.8%（+8.8ppt QoQ、
+21.9ppt YoY） ，除產品組合與報價效益外，二代布量產良率亦已逐步改善。
營業利益 10.39 億元（+89.8% QoQ、+301.5% YoY） ，營益率 37.6%；稅後淨
利 8.58 億元（+1.8% QoQ、+203.2% YoY），EPS 1.40 元，EPS 較 2Q26 小幅
下滑係因盈餘轉增資後股數增加。展望 4Q26，隨著二代布出貨比重持續提升
以及良率續揚貢獻，研究部預估營收 30.51 億元（+10.3% QoQ、+86.4% 
YoY） 、毛利率 49.9%、EPS 1.62 元。

2. 2027 年成長動能轉向產品組合升級，EPS 估 9.30 元 
2027 年富喬獲利成長動能將由價格上漲轉向產品組合升級與新增產能貢獻。
台灣廠持續將既有機台由一代轉向二代低介電布，東莞廠自 1Q27 起採台灣供
紗、當地織布模式，分批將 E 布產能轉作二代布；泰國一期則自 2H27 起逐
步投產，主要承接客戶對非中國高階產能的需求。隨三地產能同步往高階產品
配置，研究部預估二代低介電布營收占比將由 2026 年的 27% 提升至 2027 
年的 51%，成為獲利成長的主要來源。研究部預估 2027 年營收 149.82 億元
（+52.4% YoY） ，並隨泰國產能開出及二代布占比提升呈逐季成長；毛利率升
至 54.8%，營益率達 45.7%，帶動稅後淨利 57.18 億元（+81.4% YoY），EPS 
9.30 元。

2H26 受惠二代低介電布需求放
量 、 漲價效益與良率改善 ， 富喬營
收與毛利率同步攀升，研究部預
期 3Q26、4Q26 營運將連續改寫
新高。

2027 年富喬成長動能將由漲價
轉 向 產 品 組 合 升 級 與 新 產 能 貢
獻 ， 隨台灣 、 東莞及泰國產能加速
轉向二代低介電布，研究部預估
二代布營收占比升至 51%，帶動 
EPS 成長至 9.30 元。

投資建議 
研究部初次給予富喬買進投資評等，主要考量：(1) 石英布受鑽孔損耗與加
工良率限制 ， 導入時程遞延 ， 終端客戶轉回採用二代低介電布搭配高階樹脂的
架構，延長二代布產品週期，帶動富喬二代低介電布營收占比由 2025 年的 
7%，提升至 2026 年的 27% 與 2027 年的 51%；(2) 玻纖布織布機由豐田獨
家供應，目前新機交期已排至 2031 年，意味 2027 年以前產業新增供給主
要仰賴既有機台重新配置 ， 富喬可在無須大幅增加資本支出的情況下 ， 持續將
既有產能由 E 布轉向一代及二代低介電布，研究部推算二代布毛利率較一代
布高逾 10 個百分點，產品組合優化將推升毛利率由 2025 年的 27.6%，提
升至 2026 年的 44.7% 與 2027 年的 54.8%；(3) 東莞廠自 1Q27 起採台灣
供紗、當地織布模式，分批將既有產能轉作二代低介電布，泰國一期則規劃  
500 台織機，自 2H27 起逐步開出，同樣以低介電布為主要產品，並承接客
戶對非中國產能的需求 。綜上所述 ， 研究部預估富喬 2026、2027 年稅後 EPS 
分別為 5.13 元與 9.30 元，稅後純益分別年增 267.9% 與 81.4%。考量富
喬為日系龍頭以外少數具備紗、布垂直整合與自有配方 能力的供應商，以  
2027 年獲利為評價基礎，給予 20 倍本益比，目標價 185 元，初次給予買
進投資評等。

營收走勢圖

電子–通信網路  
全新(2455.TT) 
產能不是問題，基板供應改善推升營收獲利成長

研究部初次給予全新買進建議，主因為：(1)InP 基板供應改善帶
動光電子快速放量，且高毛利光電子占比由 1H26 約 26%提升至 7 月
40%、8 月 46.1%，光電子超越微電子的黃金交叉將近；(2)產品組合轉
佳 、 較高毛利的客供料占比逐步提升及價格調整效益帶動獲利改善 ， 管
理層預期 3Q26 毛利率可回升至 40%以上；(3)展望 2027 年，美系客戶
200G PD 預計 1Q27 開始明顯放量，CW Laser 及 EML 發射端則接續放
量，管理層預期2027 年發射端營收有望超越接收端。綜上所述，研究
部預估全新2026/2027 營收為49.02/78.77 億元 ， 分別年增45%/60.7%，
EPS 分別為 6.08/11.63 元，評價方面，考量目前上游磊晶需求持續強
勁，且基板供應逐步改善有望帶動營收獲利成長，因此給予60 倍本益
比，目標價 700 元(60PER*2027EPS)。

1. 3Q26 基板供貨穩定帶動高毛利光電子營收佔比提升 
研究部預估3Q26 營收將季增 44.2%達13.92 億元，EPS 為1.69 元，
主係:(1)基板供應穩定加上客戶自行攜帶基板數量增加；(2)高毛
利光電子營收佔比持續提升 。 預估毛利率達42.3%， 季增3.7ppts，
短期營運動能持續向上。

2. MOCVD 產能持續擴充，產能不成問題，2027 年光電子成長可期 
7 月整體MOCVD 稼動率僅約 50%，2027 年GaAs 及InP 共用的MOCVD
機台數新增至 66 台，後續有望隨 InP 需求，調整成 InP 產能使
用，滿足光電子產品後續需求。展望 2027 年，接收端 200G PD 於
1Q27 開始放量，發射端 CW Laser 及 EML 於 1H27 開始量產，且發
射端有望超越接收端，成為 2027 年光電子營收成長動能。

### Page 2

請參見末頁重要披露及免責聲明 2

公司簡介 
全新光電（2455）成立於1996 年，為全球主要Ⅲ-V 族化合物半導體專業磊
晶廠，以MOCVD（金屬有機化學氣相沉積）為核心技術，主要提供客戶磊晶
晶圓 ， 產品可分為微電子及光電子兩大領域 。 微電子產品以GaAs HBT、PHEMT
等磊晶片為主，主要應用於手機、Wi-Fi、基地台等射頻功率放大器 （PA），
目前為全球最大 GaAs PA 磊晶供應商；光電子產品則涵蓋 InGaAs PD/APD、
FP/DFB Laser 及 VCSEL 等磊晶片，應用於光通訊、資料中心、LiDAR 及感測
等市場。2Q26 產品組合為微電子 73%、光電子 27%。

圖一、全新 2Q26 營收佔比

資料來源：全新，統一投顧整理

產業概況 
(1) 手機進入成長高原期，WiFi7/8 與新興終端擴大GaAs 應用場景 
GaAs憑藉高頻、高線性度及高功率效率等特性，長期為無線通訊RF前端的
重要材料，主要應用於PA、LNA及部分Switch，其中HBT仍為手機與WiFi PA
的主流技術。過去GaAs需求主要隨智慧型手機通訊規格升級而成長，隨4G
進入5G後，新增頻段使PA數量及RF前端複雜度同步提升，5G手機所需GaAs
磊晶面積約較4G增加20%～30%，帶動單機GaAs價值持續提高。

然而，隨全球智慧型手機市場逐步成熟，未來GaAs需求成長動能將由過去
依賴手機出貨量增加 ， 轉向無線通訊規格升級與連網終端數量擴張 。 其中 ，
WiFi 7為目前最明確的新增需求來源，除手機、PC及Router持續升級外，
應用範圍亦逐步延伸至AI眼鏡 、 無人機 、 機器人 、 智慧家庭及其他IoT設備 。
隨終端裝置導入更高速、更低延遲的無線連接規格，對PA輸出功率、線性
度與效率的要求同步提升，使 GaAs需求不再僅與智慧型手機銷售高度連
動，而是逐步擴展至更廣泛的連網設備市場。

全新為全球 最大砷化鎵磊晶廠 ，
近期受光通訊需求增加，光電子
產品占比逐步提升。

手機終端需求成長放緩，然規格
升級及終端應用增加，帶動 GaAs
需求提升。

請參見末頁重要披露及免責聲明 3

下一世代WiFi 8則有望延續此一規格升級趨勢。相較過去WiFi世代主要追
求傳輸速度提升，WiFi 8進一步強調低延遲、穩定連線、長距離覆蓋與更
高上行流量(uplink)效能，應用場景也更貼近AI Edge Device、機器人及
即時互聯設備。整體而言，GaAs微電子產業的成長邏輯由手機出貨成長轉
向單機RF價值提升及連網裝置數量增加。

(2)  AI光互連升級推升InP需求，成為Ⅲ-V族主要成長動能 
生成式AI帶動CSP持續擴大資料中心投資，隨GPU與ASIC叢集規模增加，光
模組規格由400G快速升級至800G、1.6T，並朝3.2T發展，使高速PD、EML及
CW Laser 需 求 同 步 提 升 。LightCounting 於2026/7 最 新 預 估 ，2026 年
Ethernet光收發模組銷售額將年增73%，並預估2031年市場規模達800億美
元，反映AI高速光互連需求仍處於快速成長階段。

隨單通道速率由100G提升至200G， 接收端PD對頻寬要求提高 ， 發射端Laser
亦朝更高功率與高速率升級，使InP成為高速光通訊的關鍵材料。另一方
面，SiPh滲透率提升並不會取代InP， 因矽本身無法有效發光 ， 仍須搭配InP 
CW Laser 作為光源；後續 NPO/CPO 導 入 亦 將 延 續 外置 光 源 需 求 。同時
LightCounting指出在近期需求再度上修後，原先預期緩解的InP Laser短
缺可能延續至2027年中，顯示InP需求增速仍高於供給擴張。

(3) 上游原料高度集中中國，地緣政治加劇Ⅲ-V族供給限制 
Ⅲ-V族上游原料供給高度集中於中國，其中全球約98%的Gallium產量來自
中國 ，InP所需Indium亦約70%由中國供應 ， 使GaAs與InP供應鏈對中國政策
高度敏感 。 隨中美科技競爭升溫 ， 中國自2023年起對Gallium及相關化合物
實施出口許可，2025年再將InP基板納入出口管制，目前GaAs、Ge及InP基
板出口均須取得中國商務部許可，部分產品供貨時程已受到審批進度影
響。因此，原料供應高度集中與出口管制已成為影響Ⅲ-V族材料供應穩定
性及出貨時程的重要變數。

營運回顧及展望分析 
1. 2Q26 本業穩健改善，匯損低基期推升獲利大幅成長 
全新2Q26營收達9.65億元(+0.6%QoQ，+35.2%YoY)， 創單季歷史新高 ， 主要
受惠AI資料中心相關光電子需求持續成長，以及 Wi-Fi等微電子需求維持
穩健。毛利率為38.61%(+0.5ppts QoQ，+4.2ppts YoY)，主要受惠產品漲
價轉嫁基板及原物料成本，加上高毛利光電子產品占比提升。營業費用達
1.49億元(+7.3%QoQ，+20.6%YoY)、業外利益達0.13億元 ， 較去年同期業外
損失0.98億元大幅改善(2Q25受到新台幣急升造成匯兌損失)，使2Q26稅後
淨 利 達2.14 億元(+9.5%QoQ ，+488.3%YoY) ，EPS 為1.15 元(+8.5%QoQ ，
+475%YoY)。2Q26產品組合方面：微電子73%、光電子27%；相較1Q26微電子
75%、光電子25%，光電子營收占比持續提升。

光互連高速成長，接收發射端皆
需要 InP 關鍵材料。

鎵及銦原物料供應主要來自中國，
地緣政治成為供貨穩定的變數。

受惠於光電子需求持續成長且佔
比提升，營收創歷史新高且毛利
率季增年增。

2. 基板到位推升光電子放量，3Q26 營收獲利可望再創高 
全新 7 月 自 結 ， 營 收 達4.22 億元 (+45.11%YoY) 、 稅 後 淨 利1.15 億元
(+236.97%YoY)、EPS為0.62元 。 研究部以過往匯兌損益以及費用率去預估 ，
毛利率約為42%， 優於2Q26的38.6%， 受惠高毛利光電子產品比重提升 。8月
營收達4.71億元(+11.6%MoM，+71.2%YoY)， 累計3Q26達成率為67%， 符合研
究 部 預 期 。 產 品 組 合 方 面 ， 微 電 子 53.9%(-6ppts MoM) ，光電子
46.1%(+6ppts MoM)，光電子佔比提升受惠InP基板出口許可陸續取得、基
板供應改善 ， 以及客戶自帶基板增加 ； 然微電子進入3Q傳統手機新品旺季 ，
亦使營收穩健成長。研究部預期在光通訊需求高速成長下，預期4Q26有機
會超越微電子產品形成交叉，進而帶動整體毛利率。研究部預估3Q26營收
為13.92億元，EPS為1.69元。

3. 200G PD 1Q27 放量，CW Laser、EML 接續推升發射端成長  
接收端方面，目前新增PD專案以200G為主，美系大客戶已進入量產。目前
200G PD 占比仍低，但美系客戶客供料已陸續進廠，預計1Q27開始明顯放
量，屆時200G PD有機會占整體PD營收50%以上。200G PD技術門檻及ASP均
明顯優於100G，因此除帶動營收成長外，產品組合亦將持續往高階移動。
發射端方面，CW Laser目前已進入量產並開始出貨，2026年仍以小量出貨
為主 ， 預計2027年隨既有客戶需求提升進一步放量 。 此外 ， 目前已有陸系 、
台系及日系等多家客戶合作 ， 公司亦正與美系大客戶洽談新案 ；EML目前在
客戶驗證階段，預計於1H27開始放量，將成為發射端新增營收來源。管理
層預期2027年隨1.6T需求成長、CW Laser 及EML出貨規模擴大，以及發射
端ASP相較接收端1.5倍以上，發射端營收有望超越接收端，成為光電子下
一階段主要成長來源。

7 月及 8 月高毛利光電子營收佔
比提升，3Q26 獲利有望創高。

接收端，成為光電子產品下一階
段成長動能。

4. 既有產能彈性轉向 InP，新增機台支撐 2027 光電子成長 
全新目前共有67台MOCVD，其中64台可於GaAs及InP間彈性共用、3台為GaN
專用設備 。7月營收雖創歷史新高 ， 但產能利用率仍僅50%以上，顯示MOCVD
設備本身具有餘裕， 現階段限制光電子出貨的主要因素仍為 InP基板供應
限制。 由於GaAs與InP共用機台轉換僅需3–5天 ， 若2027年基板供應持續改
善，公司可依訂單需求及產品毛利率，逐步將部分低毛利微電子產能轉向
PD、CW Laser、EML等高毛利InP光電子產品。近期，公司因應需求再新增
2台MOCVD供InP產能使用 ， 預計3Q27到廠 ， 屆時總機台數將由67台提升至69
台。

需求端方面，Lumentum持續擴充產能，但供給仍然落後客戶需求，供需缺
口由原先的25-30%擴大至30%以上。因此研究部認為，在磷化銦基板供應逐
步改善以及供需吃緊下，全新有望將既有GaAs/InP共用機台產能轉換，逐
步轉向高單價、高毛利光電子產品。綜上所述，研究部保守假設2027年部
分GaAs產能轉為InP使用 ， 搭配新增2台InP設備貢獻 ， 預估2027年光電子營
收年增138%。

投資建議 
產能不是問題，基板供應改善推升營收獲利成長

研究部初次給予全新買進建議 ， 主因為 ：(1)InP 基板供應改善帶動光電子
快速放量 ， 且高毛利光電子占比由1H26 約26%提升至7 月40%、8 月46.1%，
光電子超越微電子的黃金交叉將近 ；(2)產品組合轉佳 、較高毛利的客供料
占比逐步提升及價格調整效益帶動獲利改善，管理層預期 3Q26 毛利率可
回升至 40%以上；(3)展望 2027 年，美系客戶200G PD 預計 1Q27 開始明顯
放量，CW Laser 及 EML 發射端則接續放量，管理層預期 2027 年發射端營
收 有 望 超 越 接 收 端 。 綜 上 所 述 ， 研 究 部 預 估 全 新2026/2027 營收為
49.02/78.77 億元，分別年增 45%/60.7%，EPS 分別為 6.08/11.63 元，評
價方面，考量目前上游磊晶需求持續強勁，且基板供應逐步改善有望帶動
營收獲利成長，因此給予 60 倍本益比，目標價 700 元(60PER*2027EPS)。

2027 年MOCVD 總台數共 69 台，66
台為 GaAs 及 InP 共用 ， 後續可依
需求轉換成 InP 產能。

## Document 067: 260914_gs_optical-tour

Source PDF: all report pdf/260914_gs_optical-tour.pdf
Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-09-14

### Page 1

1. Optical module demand outlook: Companies we visited remain positive on 
optical module demand, driven by AI server racks ramp up, optical module adoption 
expansion (from scale out to scale up / across), and specification upgrade. On global 
market demand on 800G and 1.6T, demand could be at 130m to 200m; for the China 
market, overall demand could also grow at mid double digits to 50m+ units, with the 
majority 800G and 400G, and 1.6T emerging. Nevertheless, companies we visited 
with also mentioned that tight raw material supply (e.g. DSP , lasers, PCB) could 
continue to cap shipments in 2027. The positive tone echoes our positive view on 
global demand, on which we raised 800G and above optical module demand by 39% 
/ 36% in 2027E / 2028E to 144m / 171m (report link). Supply chain positive tone 
reflects further upside to our estimates. 
2. Optical module competition: Companies we visited see pricing competition 
remaining healthy, with 800G optical module pricing decline within single digits in 
2027, and 1.6T optical module price to sustain at US$700+. Managements highlight 
that optical module is not a pure assembly but with multiple SKUs and require 
suppliers’ strong R&D and timely development as compared to telecom, the product 
cycle could shorten to 1-2 years in datacom vs. 5 years in telecom. Supply chain 
management and mass production capability are also important to win orders, 
especially under the current tight supply situation and clients’ requirements of 
diversifying production sites under geopolitical tension. Innolight, as the global 
leader works with supply chain closely, including R&D collaboration, invests directly 
in their suppliers, and pre-payment and long-term agreements to secure a

### Page 2

sustainable supply through cycles.
3. Laser supply: Chinese suppliers are ramping up capacity and capability in 200G EML,
supporting the 1.6T optical module ramp up in 2027. Nevertheless, shipment also
depends on other raw material supply (e.g. DSP), and customers penetration.
Everbright‘s laser capacity prepared for 2027 is EML slightly higher than CW laser, and
within the EML majority is for 100G, with the remaining for 200G; Dongshan Precision

highlights their 200G EML is already in mass production, while volume is still small
currently given the tight supply of DSP; nevertheless, the company also secured 10m
supply of DSP in 2027, supporting their lasers and optical modules shipment ramp up.
VPEC, global leading InP epiwafer supplier, also sees improving InP substrate supply, with
steady export permission from China government, more customers bringing InP
substrate, and growing second to fourth suppliers outside of China. VPEC’s MOCVD is

also in expansion, from current 62 MOCVD to 69 MOCVD by 2Q27, and planning a new
production site in 2027.
4. CPO timeline: As a new technology, CPO will naturally take time and could face
challenges in the path of commercialization. For example, laser suppliers see thermal
challenges for 300mW / 400mW CW lasers in ELS (external laser source), and is working
on 100mW+ with PA for NPO first. Optical module suppliers also see strong 3.2T NPO
optical engine demand across China and overseas markets. Nevertheless, equipment

suppliers remain the earliest beneficiary in CPO, with the strong testing and coupling
demand reflecting in equipment suppliers’ revenues in mid 2026. For example,
Robotechnik 2Q26 revenues were up 172% QoQ, or 141% higher than our estimates. As
we highlighted in Sep (report link), we estimate CPO switch at 10k / 92k / 131k units in
2026E-28E.
5. AI spending sustainability: Management highlighted that AI is a revolution, and we
are at an early stage of infrastructure spending and application development. It will be a

long cycle for the coming 10 to 20 years, and some of their customers are planning
beyond 2030. The demand for the coming 2 to 5 years remains very strong and
management highlighted their industry enjoys short return on investment, which is
around 1 to 2 years. Management highlighted the AI spending is not only building more
AI data centers, but also includes technology migration, such as making power
consumption more efficient, making data transmission faster, etc., driving the supply

chain growth. Compared to the internet bubble in the 2000s, management sees much
more transparency between end-customers (demand) and supply chain (supply), as end
customers are involved more in supply chain product development and capacity
investment, reducing the information gap between demand and supply, and reducing
the chance of double booking. Management noted that currently every module they
produce is being deployed in data centers, reflecting real demand.

6. Photonics IC scaling up: AI drives data transmission speed and bandwidth
requirement, leading to strong demand on Photonics IC, requesting it to catch up
Electrical IC automated production and testing ecosystem in 1 to 2 years, while EIC /
semiconductors has been developed for decades. The strong demand brings
opportunities to tool suppliers, across coupling and testing, which are necessary tools to
accelerate PIC production. Robotechnik / FiconTEC describes the number of tools they

target to ship in the coming 1 year would be over 50% of what they’ve shipped in the
past 25 years, reflecting the strong demand and orders visibility.

### Page 3

7. Testing - CPO earliest beneficiary: As a new technology, CPO naturally takes time
and faces challenges in the path of commercialization; however, we identify testing
equipment suppliers as the earliest beneficiaries, considering the expensive final module
means multiple testing during the production process is necessary, given the earlier a
failure is found, the lower cost a failure is. As a result, companies we visited continue to
see Insertion 2 (double-sided wafer-level testing) as necessary, and Robotechnik /

FiconTEC launched the new generation in 3Q26, which fully complied with the global
leading foundry’s communication infrastructure.
8. Testing - shortening time with KGD (know good die) at early stage: To facilitate
photonics IC scaling up, not only are more tools needed but better tools, requiring
suppliers’ strong R&D and execution, delivering continuous specification upgrade.
Robotechnik / FiconTEC, as global leaders in PIC testing, aim to shorten the wafer-level

testing time by 50-60% next year, and target 4x faster die-level testing next year.
Enlitech (7728.TWO, Not Covered) offers NightJar, a hyperspectral image system,
revealing AWG (arrayed waveguide grating) optical loss pathways with absolute optical
power mapping, allowing customers to KGD at Insertion 1 (PIC wafer testing) or Insertion
0 (PIC wafer early defect screening), saving failure costs.
9. Coupling - automated production becoming necessary in high-speed connection:

AI drives optical module towards high speed and high density / bandwidth, driving
demand on automated production. GMT (4573.TWO, not covered) showcased dual FA
active alignment equipment for 1.6T optical module, which could do the coupling for
both Tx and Rx simultaneously, saving 50% of coupling time compared to traditional
equipment. FitTech (6706.TW, not covered) has showcased an optical engine assembly
system, featuring passive / active alignment and customized development of coupling

algorithms, which could be used in multiple products: high-speed optical modules, ELS,
OCS, NPO, CPO, SiPh and optical chiplets. ASMPT has showcased MEGA multi-chip
bonding solution for complex multi-chip and photonics packaging applications,
combining high-precision placement with adhesive dispensing, UV fixation and 3D
inspection in one platform.
10. FAU & Laser specification upgrade: With optical networking expanding from scale
out to scale up, FAU and laser specification is also migrating. FOCI‘s FAU in 2026 to be

mainly 40 channels (starting in 3Q26) for 3.2T, followed by 80 channels (within 2026) for
6.4T, and 100 channels under R&D, per management. The company’s FAU enjoys several
customers across fabless, foundry, laser suppliers, etc. FOCI Aug revenues accelerated to
+20% MoM (vs. +9% MoM in Jul), reflecting the ramp up of high-end FAU. VPEC‘s
optoelectronics revenues enjoy strong growth on the back of strong CW lasers demand
and InP substrate supply getting better. Its InP epiwafer for CW lasers is also migrating

from 70mW / 100mW (scale out) to above 100mW (scale up, NPO) and 300mW /
400mW (scale up, CPO), along with expansion from CW lasers to 100G / 200G EML,
supporting its growth ahead.

Price Target Risks and Methodology - Zhongji Innolight Co.
Valuation: Our 12-m TP for Innolight A-share of Rmb2,645 is based on 35.6x 2027E P/E,
and our 12-m TP for Innolight H-share of HK$3,267 is based on a H-A premium of 13%.
We derive our target P/E multiple from the networking peers’ trading P/E vs.
forward-year fundamentals (NI YoY and OPM). Compared to Innolight’s historical trading
range, the target multiple reflects our view of its leading market position in high-speed

connections and product-mix upgrade toward SiPh optical modules, driving GM
expansion. We are Buy rated.
Key downside risks: 1) slower-/worse-than-expected 800G+ optical modules demand;
2) slower/worse-than-expected new optical devices ramp pace; 3)
faster-than-expected market share normalizing in 800G+ optical modules; 4)
geopolitical risks; and 5) worsening component supply situation to constrain shipment
growth.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - VPEC

Valuation: We adopt a discounted P/E method and apply a 22.2x target P/E on VPEC’s
2029E EPS, discounting back to 2027E at a COE of 10.5% (beta 1.7x, risk free rate 1.6%
and market risk premium at 5.1%), to derive our 12m TP of NT$793. Our target P/E is
based on a 0.4x PEG&M ratio derived from the average level of peers in the photonics
supply chain.
Key risk: Slower-than-expected SiPh business ramp up; weaker-than-expected
microelectronics demand from smartphones clients; IDM offers EPI wafer in-house.

Price Target Risks and Methodology - RoboTechnik
Valuation: Our 12-month target price of Rmb796 is based on a 20.7x 2031E P/E,
discounted back to 2027E at a COE of 11.3%. Our target multiple is derived from the
correlation between consumer electronic peers’ PEG&M (2026E P/E to 2027E NI YoY and
OPM), with RoboTechnik’s 2032E net income at 2% YoY and 2032E OPM at 32%.
Key downside risks: Fiercer-than-expected market competition; lower-than-expected

optical connection end demand; worse-than-expected photovoltaic market downcycle.
Valuation: Our 12-month target price of NT$833 is based on a 15.4x 2030E P/E,
discounted back to 2027E at a COE of 12.6%. Our target multiple is derived from peers’
correlation between forward-year trading P/E and earnings growth.
Key downside risks: Fiercer-than-expected market competition, technology migration
trends in optical networking, and slower-than-expected capacity ramp-up.

Price target methodology and risks - ASMPT
Valuation methodology: We are Neutral rated on ASMPT with a 12-month target price
of HK$177, which is based on a 24.9x 2030E discounted P/E (discounted back to 2027E).
Our target P/E is derived from correlation between peers P/E to the sum of NI YoY and
OPM.
Key upside/downside risks: 1) customers’ faster-/slower-than-expected adoption of
Advanced Packaging tools; 2) stronger-/weaker-than-expected demand from

automotive customers; and 3) stronger-/weaker-than-expected demand for traditional
IC packaging and SMT equipment.

Greater China Technology Hardware

Industry View In-Line
Overall August ODM notebook shipments came in 19% below our estimate: Pull-
forward demand appears to have come to an end, channel partners and distributors
have stocked up on inventory, and OEMs are slowing their sales into the channel.
We believe this is the main reason why August NB builds came in slower than our

expectation. However, we continue to expect product mix to continue to shift
toward higher-end, more-profitable models. Several ODMs such as Quanta and
Compal have even lowered 3Q NB build forecasts compared to their earlier guidance
on 2Q earnings calls three weeks ago. Thus we lower our 3Q NB build estimate by
7% to 25.4M units (-16% q/q, -25% y/y). This sequential decline is sub-seasonal vs.
the 15-year average seasonality of +5% q/q in 3Q, and implies September NB builds

at 9.9M units (+35% m/m, -18% y/y).
We introduce our 4Q notebook build estimate at 23.9M units (-6% q/q, -26% y/
y): This sequential decline is sub-seasonal (despite an already lowered base in 3Q)
vs. the 15-year average seasonality of flat q/q in 4Q. None of the ODMs have
provided official guidance for 4Q notebook builds, but our preliminary checks
suggests that they will continue to fall q/q. On our estimate, this implies that the
top 5 Taiwan NB ODMs' builds for CY26 will come in at ~108.8M units (-16% y/

communications with a subject company, public appearances
and trading securities held by a research analyst account.
Key Takeaways
Top five ODMs' August 2026 NB shipments were 7.3M units (-11% m/m, -35% y/y),
19% below our estimate.
We see September 2026 NB builds at 9.9M units (+35% m/m, -18% y/y).
We lower our 3Q26 NB build estimate by 7% to 25.4M units (-16% q/q, -25% y/y).
We introduce our 4Q26 NB build estimate at 23.9M units (-6% q/q, -26% y/y).

Our top five ODMs' CY26 NB build estimate is ~108.8M units (-16% y/y).

## Document 074: 260914_nmr_chipbond-UG

### Page 1

EQUITY: OSAT
Chipbond Technology Corporation   6147.TWO 6147 TT
Global Markets Research
14 September 2026
Concrete improvement in fundamentals in sight
Solid SiPh demand and future opportunities; baseline 
business benefiting from AI ripple effect; upgrade to Buy
Upgrade to Buy on increased progress in SiPh and potential DDIC backend reshuffles, 
with a new TP of TWD270, implying 43% upside
We were encouraged by Chipbond’s efforts to utilize its idle bumping capacity and make inroads 
into silicon photonics (SiPh) but did not upgrade the stock as we assumed that the market has 
likely priced in much more than it would deliver (report). Beside the reset in the market sentiment 
(share price -38% from the peak in late May vs. TAIEX +3%), we see increased progress in 
Chipbond’s bumping services in SiPh and that its baseline DDIC business could enjoy the “AI 
ripple effect” given a Korean DDIC vendor’s supply chain reshuffle. We lift our 2026/27/28F EPS 
from TWD4.55/5.71/ 6.70 to TWD5.77/9.04/10.60 (Fig. 2) . We upgrade Chipbond to Buy from 
Neutral and raise TP to TWD270 (from TWD171), which is based on 30x (unchanged)  2027F 
EPS of TWD9.04, at the high end of the company’s historical band (Fig. 4) to capture the 
diversification into SiPh. Chipbond currently trades at 21x 2027F EPS. Downside risks are softer-
than-expected optical communication demand and slower new project ramp-up.
TIA bumping remains the major driver in SiPh; TFLN engagement worth watching
While the addressable segments of Chipbond’s gold bumping include transimpedance amplifier 
(TIA), photodetector (PD), driver and modulator, we believe so far only TIA and PD are in 
production, and most of Chipbond’s SiPh revenue comes from 200G TIA bumping due to a 
larger die size than PD, with tie-ups with most of the major North American vendors. We estimate 
Chipbond’s SiPh revenue to grow 110%/70% in 2027-28F and contribute low-/high-teens of 
revenue vs. c.6% in 2026F; thus, a more significant mix benefit could support GM growth to 
32.7%/34.4% in 2027-28F from 29.4% in 2026F. Additionally, we believe Chipbond’s backend 
collaboration with UMC (2303 TT, Buy) in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) modulator production is 
worth watching given a much larger die size.
Share gain in LDDI backend might mitigate some device unit pressure
We expect Chipbond’s revenue growth to moderate in 4Q26F after +14% q-q growth in 3Q26F on a 
N American handset brand’s seasonal demand and SiPh resilience given continued PC/ Android 
demand headwinds to Chipbond’s baseline DDIC business (~80% of current revenue). However, 
we noted before that a Korea DDIC vendor could engage with UMC due to the company’s captive 
fab partner’s likely 8” capacity offloading amidst resource constraints  (report). The capacity 
optimization might cover more than fabrication but also gold bumping, and we think Chipbond could 
thus have the opportunity to gain LDDI backend share from 2027F in the earliest.

### Page 3

Company profile
Chipbond is one of the world's leading DDI OSAT players. Established in 1997, Chipbond specialises in providing display driver and radio-frequency
semiconductor packaging and testing services.
Valuation Methodology
Our TP of TWD270 is based on 30x 2027F EPS. Our target P/E of 30x is at the high end of the historical P/E range. TAIEX is the benchmark index.
Risks that may impede the achievement of the target price
Downside risks: 1) Softer-than-expected silicon photonic demand or fiercer competition, 2) slower-than-expected smartphone and TV demand, 3)

weaker-than-expected COF/tape demand.
ESG
Chipbond manages its corporate social responsibility by focusing on five dimensions: corporate governance, workplace of well-being, environmental
and sustainable development, customer service and supplier management, and social participation. The company sets water-saving milestones and
establishes low-carbon plants in practice.

Definition of Nomura Group's equity research rating system and sectors
The rating system is a relative system, indicating expected performance against a specific benchmark identified for each individual stock, 
subject to limited management discretion. An analyst’s target price is an assessment of the current intrinsic fair value of the stock based on an 
appropriate valuation methodology determined by the analyst. Valuation methodologies include, but are not limited to, discounted cash flow 
analysis, expected return on equity and multiple analysis. Analysts may also indicate expected absolute upside/downside relative to the stated 
target price, defined as (target price - current price)/current price.

SECTORS
A 'Bullish' stance, indicates that the analyst expects the sector to outperform the Benchmark during the next 12 months. A 'Neutral' stance, 
indicates that the analyst expects the sector to perform in line with the Benchmark during the next 12 months. A 'Bearish' stance, indicates that 
the analyst expects the sector to underperform the Benchmark during the next 12 months. Sectors that are labelled as 'Not rated' or shown as 
'N/A' are not assigned ratings. Benchmarks are as follows: United States: S&P 500; Europe: Dow Jones STOXX 600; Global Emerging 
Markets (ex-Asia): MSCI Emerging Markets ex-Asia. Japan/Asia ex-Japan: Sector ratings are not assigned.

Target Price
A Target Price, if discussed, indicates the analyst’s forecast for the share price with a 12-month time horizon, reflecting in part the analyst's 
estimates for the company's earnings. The achievement of any target price may be impeded by general market and macroeconomic trends, and 
by other risks related to the company or the market, and may not occur if the company's earnings differ from estimates.

First Read
Parade Technologies
2026 Taiwan Summit: Near-term outlook
impacted by softer NB demand
Q326 revenue tracking toward lower-end of guidance
Parade attended our 2026 Taiwan Summit on Sep 14th. August sales of NT$1,327 mn
was down 2% and flat YoY. QTD sales only reached 57% of UBSe and Street estimates,
and Parade now expects its Q326 sales could come in at the lower-end of its US$139–
153 mn guidance range, likely due to softer NB demand. Parade's GM declined by 0.1

pp QoQ to 40.2% in Q226 on OSAT price hike, as the Taiwanese OSATs have allocated
more capacity to AI-related products. Parade noted it has been adding new OSAT
partners in Korea, China, and Malaysia, while also adjusting its ASPs in Q326. It noted its
Q326F GM should come in within its 40-44% guidance range, but we believe the GM
expansion will be more moderate given the cost headwinds. Q326F OPEX guidance is
reiterated at US$33-36 mn with full year OPEX growth to be within 5% YoY, and

effective tax rate for 2026F is guided to remain slightly above 10%. It has not provided a
specific outlook for Q426 but acknowledge the challenging outlook for the laptop
market. This is consistent with our recent checks within the NB display supply chain.
ASIC for CPU chipset to tape out soon for H227 mass production
Parade highlighted its deep expertise in high-speed connectivity and proprietary IP,
which enables it to deliver customized ASIC-like solutions to its customers. While its

initial focus was  display applications, it is now expanding  into CPU chipset. It is on-track
to tape out two chipsets for its CPU  customer, targeting  different PCIe channel
configurations. Comparing with its peers solution on 28nm node, Parade believes its
product  developed on 12 nm node  offers superior power efficiency. Parade noted the
CPU chipsets are  on track for mass production by H227, although we believe ASMedia's
solution will start to ramp from mid-2027 and will split the market share with Parade.

Exploring additional growth drivers for 2027
Parade also highlighted its ongoing effort to diversify away from traditional NB display  IC
business with several initiatives expected to contribute growth from 2027F. It sees good
revenue opportunity for  integrated touch solutions (TED/TTED), especially after the
potential adoption of touch display by  its standard-plus customer. For ACC cables, it will
supply redriver  with switch function, which should be a new growth engine in 2027F as

it believes copper and optical will co-exist in the next several years. Its USB4 retimer also
has good market share at non-Intel platform and management expects the penetration
to exceed  50% in 2027 vs 40%+ in 2026. Parade also noted its automotive business
should see strong sales growth in 2027, although we estimate overall contribution for
this segment remains at low-single-digit  % of total revenue.
Valuation: Rate NEUTRAL with NT$610 PT
We have a NEUTRAL rating on Parade with NT$610 PT,  based on 14.5x forward PE.

Company Description
Founded in 2005, Parade is a mixed-signal IC fabless design house headquartered in San Jose,
CA, specialising in high-speed interface and display solutions used in PCs, servers, consumer
electronics and display panels. Parade's display solutions (55% of 2024 revenue) include

embedded display port timing controllers (eDP TCON), source drivers and touch controllers.
Parade's high-speed interface solutions (45% of 2025 revenue) include signal conditioners
for USB, PCIe, SATA, etc, as well as protocol converters and USB controllers.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
Our price target for Parade is based on target PE multiple.
Fabless integrated circuit (IC) design houses face a variety of uncertainties, including rapidly

changing technology, end-market demand, competition, employee turnover and foundry
wafer costs. They are also vulnerable to legal disputes over IP rights.
For Parade, we believe key risks include: 1) Demand dynamics in PCs/notebooks, TVs, servers,
etc., as any pickup or slowdown in these end-markets would directly impact Parade's growth
and new product rollouts. 2) The length of the qualification cycle or pace of adoption by
clients could be a key upside/downside risk to our thesis. 3) Potential new entrants in Apple's

IT display timing controllers could be a downside risk to our growth estimates. 4) Fiercer price
competition by global and Asian peers may pose downside risk to our growth and GM
forecasts. 5) Foundry and assembly cost changes could present upside/downside risks to our
GM estimates.

the relevant offering materials for that investment. Structured investments are unsecured obligations of a particular issuer with returns linked to the performance of an
underlying asset. Depending on the terms of the investment, investors could lose all or a substantial portion of their investment based on the performance of the underlying
asset. Investors could also lose their entire investment if the issuer becomes insolvent. UBS does not guarantee in any way the obligations or the financial condition of any

issuer or the accuracy of any financial information provided by any issuer. Structured investments are not traditional investments and investing in a structured investment is
not equivalent to investing directly in the underlying asset. Structured investments may have limited or no liquidity, and investors should be prepared to hold their investment
to maturity. The return of structured investments may be limited by a maximum gain, participation rate or other feature. Structured investments may include call features and,

if a structured investment is called early, investors would not earn any further return and may not be able to reinvest in similar investments with similar terms. Structured
investments include costs and fees which are generally embedded in the price of the investment. The tax treatment of a structured investment may be complex and may differ
from a direct investment in the underlying asset. UBS and its employees do not provide tax advice. Investors should consult their own tax advisor about their own tax situation

before investing in any securities.

First Read
BizLink Holding
UBS T aiwan Summit 2026 key takeaways:
margins improve as HPC sales build
Positive outlook amid market volatilities
Bizlink's share price has been volatile amid gross margin weakness in Q126 and a
conservative read-through from Credo's earnings call on AEC products. Bizlink's
management remains positive about  its order momentum in HPC products, with data
cable shipments picking up, and power cable shipments  growing alongside rack

shipments and the higher content value of Vera Rubin. After the deal's completion, the
consolidation of Interplex should further expand the HPC sales contribution and drive
further margin expansion. Meanwhile, Bizlink has also identified opportunities in optical
connections through various partnerships. Earnings contributions from XFS are growing
robustly, though they remain a small proportion of the total. ALC and other CPO
revenue might not  contribute to earnings growth until H227, at the earliest.

Expect stronger HPC sales growth and margin expansion
Bizlink attributes the MoM sales decline in August to the summer holidays at its
European factories, which account for around one-third of capacity  and mainly supply
automation and industrial products. Management highlighted the historical patterns of
MoM improvements in September. Management remains positive about HPC and
capital equipment sales growth in the remainder of 2026. Data cables shipments have

recovered meaningfully since June. Power cables are growing rapidly with shipments of
Rubin servers, which have a much higher content value per rack than Blackwell. Further
upside could come from shipment of stand alone power side cars. The consolidation of
Interplex would serve as an additional growth driver after the deal is closed before end
of 2026. A higher sales mix from HPC could also drive gross margin expansion.
Engaging in various partnerships to capture optic interconnect opportunities

Management outlined several potential opportunities in optical connections: Credo's
ALC and other Micro-LED consortium products. These products provide mid-to-short
distance optical interconnection solutions. Credo plans to hold a demonstration in
October 2026, and Bizlink is the exclusive supplier. On CPO, Bizlink performs  fibre
assembly and supplies MPO connectors. It collaborates with FAU companies, including
Senko, and is working on solutions for shuffle boxes.

Valuation: Buy, price target at NT$3,617
We have a Buy rating with price target of NT$3,617, based on 30x 2027E PE.

Company Description
Founded in 1996, BizLink is headquartered in Fremont, California. BizLink provides
interconnect solutions, including connectors, harnesses and cables for a wide range of
industries, such as industrials, automotive, IT & data communications, and electrical

appliances. BizLink has 34 production facilities located in Asia, America and Europe.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
Our price target is based on a PE multiple.
The key company-specific risks are: 1) a global economic slowdown impacting end-demand;
2) a slower-than-expected change in the product mix leading to slower-than-expected
gross margin expansion; and 3) a rise in raw material prices.
The key industry-specific risks are: unexpected changes in the underlying global macro

environment, currency and interest rate movement and commodity price inflation.

Investing in structured investments involves significant risks. For a detailed discussion of the risks involved in investing in any particular structured investment, you must read

the relevant offering materials for that investment. Structured investments are unsecured obligations of a particular issuer with returns linked to the performance of an
underlying asset. Depending on the terms of the investment, investors could lose all or a substantial portion of their investment based on the performance of the underlying
asset. Investors could also lose their entire investment if the issuer becomes insolvent. UBS does not guarantee in any way the obligations or the financial condition of any

issuer or the accuracy of any financial information provided by any issuer. Structured investments are not traditional investments and investing in a structured investment is
not equivalent to investing directly in the underlying asset. Structured investments may have limited or no liquidity, and investors should be prepared to hold their investment
to maturity. The return of structured investments may be limited by a maximum gain, participation rate or other feature. Structured investments may include call features and,

if a structured investment is called early, investors would not earn any further return and may not be able to reinvest in similar investments with similar terms. Structured
investments include costs and fees which are generally embedded in the price of the investment. The tax treatment of a structured investment may be complex and may differ
from a direct investment in the underlying asset. UBS and its employees do not provide tax advice. Investors should consult their own tax advisor about their own tax situation

before investing in any securities.

(ESG) factors into investment process and portfolio construction. Strategies across geographies approach ESG analysis and incorporate the findings in a variety of ways.

would be consistent with its investment objective and other principal investment strategies. The returns on a portfolio incorporating ESG factors or sustainable investing
considerations may be lower or higher than portfolios where ESG factors, exclusions, or other sustainability issues are not considered by the portfolio manager, and the
investment opportunities available to such portfolios may differ.

Greater China Technology Hardware
Asia Pacific
Industry View In-Line
What’s new? EMC (2383.TW) shares fell 7.7% and TUC (6274.TWO) shares declined
6.7% on Sep 17, vs TAIEX +0.8%. Following the sell-off, investors have questioned
whether CPO could disrupt demand for high-end CCL. The concern is that
integrating optical engines alongside the ASIC on the package substrate shortens
high-speed electrical signal paths that would otherwise traverse the printed circuit

board (PCB), potentially reducing the need for ultra-low-Dk/Df, high-speed CCL.
Our thoughts:  This is not a new debate. We previously discussed the potential
implications of CPO for high-speed CCL demand here and here.  We believe this is
particularly relevant for scale-up architectures, where CPO adoption still faces
meaningful challenges related to cost, manufacturing yield, reliability, serviceability,
and thermal management. As such, we believe the risk of a broad-based reduction in

CCL requirements across AI systems before 2028 remains limited.  We would view
CPO-driven pullbacks in CCL stocks as potential opportunities to accumulate.
Morgan Stanley does and seeks to do business with
companies covered in Morgan Stanley Research. As a result,
investors should be aware that the firm may have a conflict of
interest that could affect the objectivity of Morgan Stanley
Research. Investors should consider Morgan Stanley
Research as only a single factor in making their investment

communications with a subject company, public appearances
and trading securities held by a research analyst account.
Key Takeaways
Co-packaged optics (CPO) is a long-term risk, not an imminent demand
disruption.
While we agree that broader CPO adoption represents a credible longer-term risk
to premium copper-clad laminate (CCL) content, we see limited risk to the
demand outlook over 2026–28.
We see limited near-term impact on CCL demand or our earnings estimates for

EMC and TUC, leaving our premium-CCL supply-tightness thesis and constructive
fundamental view intact.

## Document 093: 260918_daiwa_ Jentech

Source PDF: all report pdf/260918_daiwa_ Jentech.pdf
Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-09-18
Pages: 8
Extraction status: ok

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

What’s new: We received an update from Jentech on 18 September. Its 
share price has been negatively impacted week to date by market talk 
concerning the adoption of removable lids in Vera Rubin and Rubin Ultra. 
However, we maintain our positive view on its ongoing product-upgrade 
roadmap and expect the ASP-upgrade trend to continue in the following 
years. We reaffirm our Buy (1) call (see our latest memo, Record-high 
monthly revenue for August; 3Q26 QTD revenue tracking ahead, on 7 
September 2026).

What’s the impact: Promising ASP upgrade trend. Due to rising thermal 
design power (TDP), we expect the ASP of Jentech’s removable lid for 
Vera Rubin or Rubin Ultra to be 5-6x higher vs. that of the current one-
piece lid. Following better-than-expected shipments during the ramp-up of 
Vera Rubin, we now forecast its 3Q26 revenue at TWD9.65bn (previously 
TWD9.26bn vs. Bloomberg consensus of TWD9.62bn) and 4Q26 revenue 
at TWD10.62bn (previously TWD10.20bn, vs. Bloomberg consensus of 
TWD10.32bn). We believe there could be some revenue upside potential, 
subject to the adoption of removable lids for Vera Rubin or Rubin Ultra. We 
now forecast an EPS CAGR of 86.1% over 2026-28E, from 78.8% 
previously, as we believe further product upgrades and a favourable 
product mix should continue to support improving profitability.

Bright outlook for GPU projects as well as ASIC projects. We believe 
Jentech has a more promising product roadmap for ASIC clients, with 
potential ASP upgrades from the current stiffener. After GPU clients adopt 
removable lids, it also could encourage its ASIC clients to adopt removable 
lids, translating to 15-20x ASP increase from here. We raise our 2026-28E 
EPS by 6-15%, mainly as a result of our more aggressive revenue and 
gross-/operating-margin assumptions.

What we recommend: We reiterate our Buy (1) call and raise our 12M TP 
to TWD9,420 (from TWD6,770), still based on a target PER of 73x (vs. its 
past-3-year PER range of 17-62x) applied to our 1-year forward EPS 
forecast, which is rolled over to 4Q26E-3Q27E (from 3Q26E-2Q27E). We 
believe our target valuation is fair, given Jentech’s strong earnings visibility 
and leading position in chip-level thermal solutions, which we believe 
warrant a rerating in addition to its strong moat and competitive landscape 
in the segment. Downside risks: weaker-than-expected global AI server 
demand and slower-than-expected thermal spec upgrades.

How we differ: Our 2026-28E EPS are 1-10% above Bloomberg 
consensus, likely as we are more aggressive in our revenue and gross-
/operating-margin assumptions.

18 September 2026

Coherent Corp (COHR.K)

Strategy and positioning: Management launched PhotonLink as an architecture-
agnostic integrated optics platform covering CPO, NPO, and chip-to-chip optical
connections. It spans the full optical chain: Generating the light, shaping and
guiding it, and detecting it at the far end. Management discussed that its
customers asked it to supply complete assemblies rather than individual
components as stitching together lasers, fiber and passive optics is difficult. It

argued that no other company holds the full portfolio in-house and that Coherent
can manufacture at datacenter scale. Management expects a mix of adoption
paths, with some customers going straight to CPO and others starting with NPO
and moving to CPO later.
Figure 1. COHR's Portfolio of Optical AI Networking Products
Source: COHR at ECOC
Customers and content: In a full-solution example (combining the ELS, the
assembly to the switch or XPU, and the assembly out to the faceplate),

management said Coherent content could reach up to $15k of content per
switch/processor chip needing 100T of I/O capacity at 200G optical lane. Coherent
counts more than 10 customer engagements each in CPO and NPO and more than
5 in chip-to-chip, with activity going up sharply over the past six months. For CPO,
management said it has an anchor customer with an LTA secured, which it
identified as NVDA. It also has an anchor customer and LTA for NPO, which it did

not name. Separately, management cited two LTAs for ultra-high-power CW lasers
with leading hyperscale or AI datacenter customers, also unnamed.

### Page 3

Coherent Corp (COHR.K)
21 September 2026 Citi Research
3
Figure 2. PhontonLink Platform
Source: COHR at ECOC 2026
Timing: CPO for scale-out, tied to the NVIDIA agreement, begins ramping in the
December quarter (calendar Q4 2026). CPO for scale-up follows in the second half
of calendar 2027. NPO ramps in the second half of next calendar year, mainly for
scale-up. Chip-to-chip is further out, around 2029-2030.
Light generation: The ultra-high-power CW laser sits in an external laser source

that holds up to eight lasers, each feeding roughly four links. It starts ramping this
quarter, with significant volume next year, on the 6-inch InP platform in Sherman,
Texas. For NPO, a high-power buried-heterostructure CW laser is already shipping
in millions of units per month for pluggables. VCSEL arrays come in a conventional
version for ribbon fiber and a high-density 2D version that can be flip-chipped
directly to drivers and TIAs with backside lenses. Photodetectors run to 200G

today, with 400G in development.
Figure 3. UHP CW Laser Leader
Source: COHR at ECOC 2026

### Page 4

Coherent Corp (COHR.K)
21 September 2026 Citi Research
4
Fab footprint: Sherman runs 6-inch InP and GaAs, Sweden runs 6-inch InP . Zurich
runs 6-inch GaAs and is adding 6-inch InP for high-power lasers, while Fremont
runs a 3-inch line. GaAs capacity has grown fourfold since the 6-inch move about
six years ago, with capacity for over one billion VCSEL arrays per year. InP capacity
doubled last year, a quarter ahead of schedule, and management plans to double it

again or more.
Figure 4. COHR Capacity Expansion
Source: COHR at ECOC 2026
Shape, guide, and receive: Coherent grows garnet in the United States and says it
supplies a significant fraction of the industry's garnet and isolators, with
customers signing LTAs for capacity. The ELS is built on the transceiver line and is
sampling now. The rest of the portfolio covers specialty fiber (polarization-
maintaining fiber production-ready, mode-matched fiber introduced at ECOC,

multi-core fiber), micro-lens arrays, V-grooves, fiber array units, a detachable
connector, circulators, WDM multiplexers, and fiber shuffles.
Silicon photonics and engines: Management discussed Coherent having an in-
house silicon photonics design team, uses foundries for wafers, and does assembly
and test in-house. It ships 200G-per-lane silicon photonics in transceivers today
and showed a 400G link at OFC with a post-deadline paper. It has a 6.4T silicon

photonics NPO module (32 lanes of 200G) and a VCSEL-based NPO with 2D
arrays, which management says achieves about 1.2 pJ/bit including the laser.
Architecture trade-off: Management said NPO is easier to deploy and service but
costs power and signal integrity versus CPO, and that a common NPO socket can
take silicon photonics or VCSELs. It positioned Coherent as an honest advisor
because it can compare all the options. Chip-to-chip is a growing topic, with WDM

and circulators important there.

Key takeaways from Citi discussion with management:
What is Coherent's competitive advantage in 3.2T, and will it participate?
Management said it has already demonstrated the building blocks for the 3.2T
generation, including 400G-per-lane EMLs and 400G silicon photonics, and
expects to participate just as it enables 1.6T today. Management showed these

demonstrations as early as two years ago.
What is the gross margin path, and what offsets mix pressure? Management
mentioned that the 42%+ target was deliberately open-ended and that it expects
to exceed it. It cautioned against expecting a step change over the next two to
three quarters. Fast transceiver growth is a mix headwind, offset by overhead
absorption, yield gains and factory consolidation. Management expects the 800G-
to-1.6T transition to be margin-accretive, with the cutover forecast around 2028.

### Page 6

Coherent Corp (COHR.K)
21 September 2026 Citi Research
6
OCS, shipping for two to three quarters, is the first of the new platforms to
generate revenue. OCS, CPO and multi-rail will contribute more to margins as mix
builds.
What are the challenges and economics of the 6-inch InP transition?
Management said it announced 6-inch capability in March 2024 after years of
work with substrate vendors that began before the AI boom. Output is expected to
be roughly 50/50 between 3-inch and 6-inch by the end of the quarter, with all

incremental capacity on 6-inch, reaching about 75% by the end of 2027. A 6-inch
die costs about half as much per yielded die, and each line delivers about four
times the capacity. Yields are better on modern tooling. Management cited a three-
to-four-year lead over competitors and secured substrate supply from five
suppliers across three continents. It also credited its 6-inch GaAs VCSEL line to a
large consumer-electronics customer that demanded the larger wafer size.

Will Coherent keep external InP suppliers? COHR only sources EMLs externally
and that it will keep some external supply for continuity on a critical component.
How does Coherent differ from Chinese laser suppliers? Management argued
that module assembly is easier to replicate but high-speed lasers are not. It said
there are no high-speed EMLs or broadband tunable lasers from China, and that
Chinese CW lasers top out around 70-100 mW. It sees only one InP laser

competitor worth naming and expects new Chinese module entrants to take share
from existing Chinese suppliers rather than from Coherent.
Does NPO vs CPO matter for content, and can low-power lasers serve NPO?
Management said it does not matter much, because the components and dollar
content are similar. Designs are custom and take 18 to 24 months to reach volume,
and management reiterated scale-up production revenue in the second half of next
year. Management rejected the view that NPO can use low-power lasers, arguing

that coupling several weak lasers loses light and defeats the power-efficiency
purpose.
What is multi-rail, and how is it progressing? Multi-rail addresses scale-across
links between data centers. Management said it delivers four times the capacity in
the same footprint at roughly 30% lower power per lane, enabled by a multi-chip
uncooled pump that it says has no comparable competitor. Small shipments are
underway and production shipments begin in the first half of next calendar year. It

sells at the component, module, line-card and system level, including white-label
to OEMs.

Coherent Corp
Company description
COHR is a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops
engineered materials and opto-electronic components for industrial
materials processing, communications, aerospace and defense, consumer
electronics, semiconductor capital equipment, life sciences and automotive
end markets. COHR produces a wide variety of application-specific photonic
and electronic materials and components, and deploys them in various forms,

including integration with advanced software. COHR's customer base
includes original equipment manufacturers, laser end users, system
integrators of high-power lasers, manufacturers of equipment and devices for
industrial, optical communications, consumer electronics, security and
monitoring applications, U.S. government prime contractors, and various U.S.
government agencies. COHR is a headquartered in Pennsylvania.
Investment strategy
We are Buy-rated on COHR. We believe that the stock's multiple will benefit

from the AI appeal while its fundamentals should expand on new
management's strong execution and focus on profitability.
Valuation
We value COHR at $420 or 30x forward P/E applied to FY2028 EPS of ~$16
discounted back. Our COHR valuation is nevertheless at a 10% discount to
the average forward P/E of AI optics peers to reflect a lower AI sales mix and
3-year EPS CAGR vs peers such as LITE.
Risks
Downside risks to the achievement of our target price include: 1) increased

competition on AI and SiC leads to limited market share growth and limited
revenue upside, 2) inability to achieve synergies and margin targets
established post acquisition of Finisar, and 3) prolonged economic recession
leads to slower 5G build-out and lower consumer demand driving revenue of
COHR down.
Upside risks to the achievement of our target price include: 1) gaining share in
AI and SiC market through new product offerings and first to market status

on larger wafer sizes, 2) quicker and stronger adoption of AI workloads,
electric and autonomous vehicles, and 3) quicker return of margins to pre-
Finisar acquisition levels.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

Price Target Risks and Methodology - Quanta 
We are Neutral-rated on Quanta. Our 12-month target price of NT$299 is based on an 
10.7x 2027E P/E, which references PC/server peers’ EPS growth vs. P/E multiple 
correlation. We see EPS growth as a major factor for the stock’s performance.  
Key upside/downside risks include: 1) stronger-/weaker-than-expected PC market 
recovery; 2) faster-/slower-than-expected AI server ramp-up; and 3) 
stronger-/weaker-than-expected demand for general servers.

Key Call: MediaTek Inc.
Multiple catalysts ahead on TPU; quantifying
upside in new ASIC projects
Stronger TPU upside in 2028-29E
We believe the market has not fully priced in MediaTek's strategic value and opportunity
in Google TPU, and view several catalysts ahead. We keep TPU sales at US$18bn in
2027E, but raise 2028/29E to US$43.5bn/52.5bn from 35.0/40.0bn previously, as we
factor in longer product cycle of v8t in 2028E and stronger growth of v9 in 2029E. See

our TPU financial analysis in Figure 1U B S  f o r e c a s t s  f o r   M e d ia T e k ' s  T P U  b u s in e s s . Catalysts in next 6-9 months include 1) v9 tape out
delivery by Nov 2026E, 2) improving visibility and execution of Intel EMIB-T, 3) Google
further raising v9 volume forecast in H127 assuming constructive feedback from v9
system verification, 4) MediaTek upgrading TPU guidance during their earnings
conference in Oct, Jan/Feb.
MediaTek potentially adding CoWoS on top of EMIB-T to ramp more v9 in 2028-

29
We are increasingly more optimistic about MediaTek's TPU v9 volume potential in 2028-
29. Overall execution of Google and MediaTek appears smoother for v9 compared with
v8t, and the tape out is so far on track for delivery by Nov 2026. On EMIB-T, our deep
dive suggests better than feared execution for substrate manufacturing at Ibiden, with
increasing support from Unimicron, Shinko, and more suppliers. EMIB-T supply should
be sufficient to drive >2m v9 volume in 2028. However, EMIB-T substrate could be tight

if v9 volume grows to 4m or more in 2029. We believe that, likely due to supply
consideration, MediaTek could be engaging with TSMC to add a CoWoS solution for v9.
It's still early stage, but could reflect the meaningful upside potential for v9 into 2029.
Upside risk from new ASIC projects
MediaTek has been proactively exploring new projects to further scale ASICs sales. There
are two projects with higher possibility, although not yet finalized. 1) SpaceX's Dojo 3

based on TSMC N2 and SoW (System on Wafer) packaging. MediaTek could be
collaborating with Nvidia to offer NVLink Fusion to secure this project. 2) Tesla's AI6 for
ADAS and robotics, which could be first produced at Intel fab, followed by Terafab. Tesla
is already deploying AI6 at TSMC and Samsung Foundry, but the goal could be to move
more volume to Terafab if the ramp is successful. Our initial view is both projects
combined could drive up to US$10-15bn ASIC revenue opportunity for MediaTek. We

expect both projects to be finalized soon in coming months given the goal to enter mass
production by 2029.
Valuation: reiterate Key Call Buy; raising price target to NT$7,300
We fine tune 2027E EPS on softer smartphone outlook but raise 2028/29E EPS by
21/28%. Our 2028 EPS estimate is 44% above consensus. Raise price target to NT
$7,300 from NT$6,500 based on unchanged 27x 2027-28E PE. Reiterate Key Call Buy.

Company Description
MediaTek is a leading integrated circuit (IC) design company in Taiwan, focusing on solutions
from the edge to the cloud, applications for its product offerings range from smartphones,
smart homes and AI PCs to high-performance computing, automotive, and AI data centers.

Valuation Method and Risk Statement
Our price target for MediaTek is based on a target PE methodology.
Fabless integrated circuit (IC) design houses face a variety of uncertainties, including rapidly
changing technology, end-market demand, competition, employee turnover and foundry
wafer costs. They are also vulnerable to legal disputes over intellectual property rights. In
addition, MediaTek is exposed to potential price competition in handset SoC, TV SoC, etc.

Downside risks include slower-than-expected market share gains and a weaker-than-
expected demand recovery.

Investing in structured investments involves significant risks. For a detailed discussion of the risks involved in investing in any particular structured investment, you must read

the relevant offering materials for that investment. Structured investments are unsecured obligations of a particular issuer with returns linked to the performance of an
underlying asset. Depending on the terms of the investment, investors could lose all or a substantial portion of their investment based on the performance of the underlying
asset. Investors could also lose their entire investment if the issuer becomes insolvent. UBS does not guarantee in any way the obligations or the financial condition of any

issuer or the accuracy of any financial information provided by any issuer. Structured investments are not traditional investments and investing in a structured investment is
not equivalent to investing directly in the underlying asset. Structured investments may have limited or no liquidity, and investors should be prepared to hold their investment
to maturity. The return of structured investments may be limited by a maximum gain, participation rate or other feature. Structured investments may include call features and,

if a structured investment is called early, investors would not earn any further return and may not be able to reinvest in similar investments with similar terms. Structured
investments include costs and fees which are generally embedded in the price of the investment. The tax treatment of a structured investment may be complex and may differ
from a direct investment in the underlying asset. UBS and its employees do not provide tax advice. Investors should consult their own tax advisor about their own tax situation

before investing in any securities.

## Document 111: 260923_daiwa_Topoint Technology

### Page 1

Taiwan Information Technology

Background: Topoint was among the world’s top 3 PCB drill-bit suppliers 
by revenue and sales volume in 2025. It supplies drill bits and router bits to 
PCB manufacturers and expanded into PCB drilling services in 2010. In 
2Q26, drill bits accounted for 68% of revenue, while drilling services 
accounted for 32%. It operates drill-bit manufacturing facilities and drilling-
service sites in Taiwan, China and Thailand.

Highlights: AI PCB upgrades are driving drill-bit market growth. AI 
PCBs increasingly feature 30+ layers, M8-grade CCL or higher-grade 
materials, and denser routing, driving demand for PCB drill bits in 3 ways: 
1) more interconnects increase the number of holes to be drilled; 2) thicker, 
harder boards accelerate bit wear and raise consumption; and 3) more 
demanding drilling requirements support greater adoption of high-end bits. 
Frost & Sullivan forecasts the global PCB drill-bit market to grow at a 9.6% 
CAGR in 2026-30, outpacing the global PCB market.

Customer investment underscores tight drill-bit supply. With drill-bit 
capacity running at near-full utilisation, management expects monthly drill-
bit capacity to rise from 32m units at end-2025 to 45-50m at end-2026, 70-
75m at end-2027 and 90-100m at end-2028. Notably, key customers 
Unimicron (3037 TT, TWD1,160, Buy [1], covered by Sheng Cheng), GCE 
(2368 TT, TWD1,140, Buy [1], covered by Sheng Cheng) and Zhen Ding 
(4958 TT, not rated) have participated in Topoint’s private convertible-bond 
offering, providing funding for its expansion.

Coated drill bits and high-aspect-ratio drilling driving spec upgrades. 
Tungsten is a key raw material for PCB drill bits, with Topoint sourcing it 
based on plant location. Topoint adjusts prices to reflect changes in costs 
and raised prices by 20% in 1H26. Alongside price hikes, a richer product 
mix lifted 2Q26 gross margin to a record high, up 5.2pp QoQ and 12.3pp 
YoY. As PCBs become harder, demand is shifting towards coated drill bits. 
Coatings such as diamond-like carbon improve wear resistance and bit life, 
while helping to maintain hole-wall quality and drilling yields. High-end 
coated products accounted for 56% of the drill-bit shipment mix in 1H26, up 
from 48% in 2025. Thicker boards and smaller hole diameters are also 
driving a shift towards micro drill bits with high aspect ratios, supporting 
ASPs and margins. Looking ahead, next-gen CCL materials present further 
drilling challenges: PTFE can adhere to the bit during machining, while 
quartz fibre accelerates wear. Per Topoint, these spec upgrades will sustain 
product-mix improvement and support higher margins over the long term.

Valuation: Topoint is currently trading at 17.7/13.8x 2027/28E PER based 
on Bloomberg consensus (vs. its average 1-year forward PER of 27x).

23 September 2026

A key supplier riding the drill-bit upcycle

➢ Ongoing high-end drill-bit upgrades to sustain margin expansion

3014 聯陽(ITE)

報告日期： 2026/09/11 研 究 員：羅  金 鳳 (Sunny Lo)  
壹、投 資 建 議

一. 2H26 營運將優於各大研調機構對全球 NB 預估數  
由於 AI 需求強勁帶動記憶體供不應求，價格相應上漲數倍以上，
客戶擔憂記憶體價格持續上漲而提前下單拉貨，使聯陽營運在
1Q26 淡季不淡逆勢成長後， 2Q26 營收持續成長至 18.35 億元，
QOQ+5.85% ，YOY-4.57% ，因上游封裝廠漲價影響在 1H26 仍不
明顯的情況下， 2Q26 整體毛利率仍維持在 57.21% 的高檔水準，
稅後淨利 4.88 億元 ，QOQ+6.45% ，YoY+28.41% ， 單季稅後EPS 
2.94 元，優於預期，合計 1H26 稅後 EPS 5.7 元。

因記憶體價格與去年同期相比已大漲 6～7 倍 ， 直接影響消費者對
3C 產品的購買意願 ， 因此 ， 各大研調機構均預估2026 年全球 NB
出貨量年減 10～14% 左右 ， 但聯陽除了PC/NB 相關產品外， 亦有
其他產品出貨成長，使聯陽整體營運將大幅優於全球 PC/NB 的表
現， 3Q26 為營運高峰，預估營收為 18.76 億元， QOQ+2.2% ，
YOY+4.53% ，惟毛利率將開始逐漸反映封裝成本上升的影響，使
2H26 整體毛利率表現低於 1H26 ，因此，預估聯陽 3Q26 單季稅
後 EPS 2.76 元。

二.逐步與客戶討論調漲產品價格 ， 反映原物料成本上漲 
過去一年記憶體價格大漲，雖然目前漲幅趨緩，但仍處於高檔，
包括 DDR、Embedded DRAM 等，其中與聯陽最直接相關應用於
SoC 、影像擷取運算產品的 Embedded DRAM ，價格已由去年初
的 1.5 美元上漲至目前的 10 美元，加上晶圓代工、封裝測試均朝
調漲價格的趨勢走，因此，聯陽在不影響客戶產品售價競爭力的
情況下，將與客戶討論 2H26 調漲價格事宜，以反映原物料成本
上漲的壓力，期能將毛利率守穩在 50% 以上。

三. SoC 打入印度 Tier 1 摩托車廠， 2H26 開始出貨  
聯陽目前產品營收比重為 EC 佔營收比重 50%( 因 SoC 大幅成長 ，
1H26 下滑至 40～45%) 、HSL( 高速傳輸介面 )佔 30% 、Others 佔
20+% ，與 PC/NB 相關的營收佔 70～80% ，且聯陽 NB 的 EC 在
全球市佔率 40～45% ，雖然市佔率再大幅提升的空間有限，但聯
陽持績進行大量的產品 Design in ，確保提供給客戶的產品為最新
規格及最具競爭力的，也能同步帶動聯陽的營運優於全球 NB 的
成長性，以及營運長期的成長動能。

二.營運概況及展望  
1、預估 2026 年全球 NB 出貨 YoY-15.18% 
在新冠疫情過後，及通膨的影響，品牌廠持續進行庫存去化，使
全球 NB 需求在 2022 年及 2023 年急速下降，在進行約 6～8 個
季度的庫存去化後，需求開始回穩，雖然要回到疫情期間的年增
雙位數不易 ， 但需求大致走穩 ， 使2024 年全球出貨量回升到 1.95
億台，YoY+2.42% ，2025 年在 Windows 10 EOL 及疫情期間購買
的 NB 逐漸進入換機潮的帶動下 ， 全球NB 出貨量持續呈現小幅成
長，預估為 2.02 億台， YoY+3.13% ，預估 2026 年在 AI 訓練需求
強勁了 3 年後 ， 推論的需求將開始接棒成長 ， 有利AI PC 的導入，
帶動全球 NB 成長，不過因為 AI 強勁的需求，且進入推理的代理
人 AI 後，對這憶體需求大幅成長，帶動 2Q25 後記憶體需求大幅
成長，呈現明顯供不應求，帶動記憶體報價爆漲，在記憶體價格
漲勢未歇的情況下，將影響終端的消費性電子產品，因此，預估
2026 年全球 NB 出貨量將下滑至 1.71 億台， YoY-15.18% 。

叁、業 績 及 獲 利 預 估

1、預估 3Q26 稅後 EPS 2.76 元 
雖然記憶體價格大漲衝擊 3C 產品的銷售，但聯陽除了 PC/NB 相
關產品外，亦有其他產品出貨成長，使聯陽整體營運將大幅優於
全球 PC/NB 的表現 ，3Q26 為營運高峰 ， 預估營收為18.76 億元，
QOQ+2.2% ，YOY+4.53% ，惟毛利率將開始逐漸反映封裝成本上

2、預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 10.56/10.94 元

的表現，此外，聯陽也將在與客戶在能達到雙贏的基礎之上，適

欣興 (3037 TT) 
ABF 漲幅優於預期，獲利再度上修

永豐觀點 
3Q26 欣興 ABF 報價漲幅優於預期 10 個百分點，中線T-glass 玻纖布於 3Q27 前
供給吃緊，長線 ABF 供不應求至 2030 年，載板報價可望逐季推升 5-15%，獲利
持續高速成長，近期股價下跌反應檢調搜索利空，評價已修正至合理區間。 
 投資評價與建議 
欣興受惠 ABF 帶動產品組合轉佳，長線而言 ABF 於 2030 年前供給吃緊，載板報
價漲勢由成本推升改為需求拉動，3Q26 漲幅優於預期 10 個百分點，且本波循環
公司通吃 CoWoS 及 EMIB-T 訂單，客戶遍及 GPU、ASIC 及 CPU 訂單，技術能
力僅次於龍頭廠 Ibiden， 研究部再度上調2026-2028 年稅後 EPS 至 23.57、42.71
及 65.08 元，投資建議買進，考量檢調風波對評價承壓，目標價維持 1575 元
(24X2028 EPS)。

ESG 評析 
欣興企業永續評鑑整體為 B+等，於 SASB 產業永續議題與跨產業五大永續面向平
均得分分別為 B+等與 A 等。 
SinoPac+ ESG 評鑑系統評等

### Page 2

2

欣興為國內 ABF 龍頭廠商：欣興為國內專業 IC 載板製造商，全球市佔率 18%僅
次於 Ibiden 以及 Samsung，2Q26 產品組合為 ABF(52%)、BT(9%)、HDI(27%)、
PCB(9%)、FPC(2%)及其它(1%)，其中 IC 載板毛利率優於公司平均水準。下游客
戶包含 Nokia、APPLE、Nvidia 以及 HTC，主要競爭對手為 Ibiden、Samsung、
Shinko、南電以及景碩。 
3Q26 營收達成率 69.6%， 暗示ABF 報價漲幅優於預期 ：欣興 8 月營收來到 177.46
億元(+9.2%MoM，+56.3%YoY)，除延續自 3 月以來月月創高紀錄外值得留意的
是月增及年增幅度亦同步擴大，整體 3Q26 營收達成率 69.6%亦優於原預期，暗
示 ABF 報價漲幅優於預期 10 個百分點以上，研究部上調3Q26 營收至 525.83 億
元(+22.6%QoQ，+54.7%YoY)， 毛利率25.8%， 稅後淨利93.36 億元(-28.8%QoQ，
+325.4%YoY)，稅後 EPS 5.68 元(原估 5.26 元)。 
CPU 生命週期展開使 ABF 需求更具延續性：過去 ABF 需求主要聚焦 AI Server 需
求，研究部原預估 2024-2025 年 ABF 供過於求 2%，2026 年亦難見反轉。受惠
AI Server 於 GPU 及 ASIC 需求帶動，另一方面 general server 回溫有望使 ABF
需求由高階產品延續至中階產品，Ibiden 預估相關高階 ABF 需求高速成長，加計
Production load 換算 2028 年面積需求較 2024 年增加 10.7 倍 ， 相較AI/ASIC 產
能於 2028 年擴充 1.8 倍供給仍低於需求。 
檢調搜索風波影響營運有限：日前欣興合江廠遭檢調搜索，股價亦應聲下跌，研究
部認為欣興合江廠位於中壢，主要生產 PCB 產品 2Q26 營收占比 9%，雖然後續
可能因產地標示不明影響 PCB 客戶關係 ， 惟與目前主力營運ABF 載板以及 HDI 並
無關聯。ABF 在 AI Server 需求推動下 2030 年以前供不應求，目前高階 GPU、
ASIC 產品僅 Ibiden(4062 JP)及欣興(3037 TT)具備相關供應能力，自研 CPU 則有
景碩(3189 TT) 緊追在後，考量產品認證需時 6-8 個月、關鍵壓合機台 lead time
亦 1-1.5 年，短期轉單不易。 
ABF 報價優於預期，上調 2026-2028 年營運：欣興 2026 年資本支出 537 億元，
其中 85%用於 ABF 除搭配客戶陸續啟動光復及楊梅 2 廠擴產，楊梅 3 廠可望於
4Q26-1Q27 動土，以土建時程 1.5-2 年推算 2029 年可望加入營運行列，未來 2
年資本支出亦可望維持 400 億以上水準。研究部考量 ABF 整體供給吃緊態勢延續
以及公司通吃 CoWoS 及 EMIB-T 產品，先進封裝客戶群布局廣泛，研究部上調

壹、投 資 建 議

一、 2Q26 獲利優於預期，毛利率 5.66% 
緯創 2Q26 營收 8954 億，QoQ +5.8% ，YoY +62.4% ，獲利方面，
2Q26 營業毛利 506.6 億， QoQ +14.9% ，YoY +107.2% ，毛利率
5.66% ，QoQ +0.45ppts ，YoY +1.22ppts ，營業利益 334.5 億，
QoQ +14.8% ，YoY +210.1% ，營利率 3.74% ，QoQ +0.3ppts ，
YoY +1.78ppts ，業外淨損 23.63 億，稅後淨利 148 億， QoQ 
+54% ，YOY +128% ，單季稅後 EPS 4.66 元，創單季新高。

二、受惠 AI 需求續強，，挹注下半年營收動能  
公司公告 8 月營收 4600.65 億， MoM +49.3% ，YoY +166.5% ，
今年累計營收 2.51 兆， YoY +98.9% 。展望 2H26 ，公司表示 AI
需求依舊非常強勁，受惠於新客戶以及新產品線的加入，預期 AI
伺服器下半年出貨量及營收表現將優於上半年。通用型伺服器則
預期下半年出貨持平。針對第三季新舊平台交替，公司表示，新
一代 Vera Rubin 已經開始出貨，且 GB 系列下半年仍有客戶持續
採購，並未出現新舊產品迭代的空窗期。而筆電部分，公司則是
表示，由於上半年 PC 客戶提前拉貨影響，預估下半年筆電出貨
量將較上半年衰退 10~20% 。預估公司 3Q26 營收 1.16 兆， QoQ 
+29.8% ，YoY +104.7% ，毛利率 5.7% ，營利率 3.6% ，稅後淨利
163.4 億，單季稅後 EPS 5.14 元。

三、預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 18.02/22.70 元 
展望 2026 年，公司預估， 2026 年 AI 伺服器的出貨將呈現倍增，
除了既有主要 Enterprise 客戶需求成長之外，下半年將進一步加
入新的 Enterprise 客戶與新的 CSP 客戶。而就新產品進度而言，
NVIDIA 新一代 VR 已經開始量產， CPU 機櫃、 LPU 機櫃、交換
器及儲存設備也會在下半年陸續出貨。此外， AMD MI450 系列也
會在下半年開始出貨。另外，網通方面，交換器 (Switch) 已開始出
貨給客戶，維持今年出貨量成長 10 倍以上預期，將有助於公司產
品組合的持續優化。此外，公司表示，受惠於客戶結構走向多元
化，有助於公司整體利潤率的提升。預估公司 2026 年全年營收
4.07 兆， YoY +86.5% ，毛利率 5.5% ，營利率 3.5% ，稅後淨利
572.9 億，全年稅後 EPS18.02 元。而就明年來看，公司對 2027
年展望持樂觀態度，由於新一代產品放量主要會落在 2027 年，再
加上交換機出貨亦將持續增加，並將推出 800G 、1.6T 等新規格

貳、公 司 概 況

一. 公司簡介  
緯創資通 (Wistron) 成立於 2001 年 ， 前身為宏碁電腦的研製服務部
門，現為全球領先的資通訊產業專業代工大廠 (ODM) ，為全球頂
尖品牌提供從設計、製造到售後服務的全方位解決方案。公司核
心產品線涵蓋筆記型電腦、桌上型電腦、伺服器、儲存設備、工
業電腦、網路通訊設備及行動裝置等。近年在人工智慧運算需求
激增的背景下，緯創已成功轉化為 AI 伺服器基板與模組供應鏈中
的關鍵推手，成為全球 AI 硬體基礎架構的核心供應商。在產能佈
局上，緯創於台灣新竹、林口及高雄設有研發中心與高階生產線；
中國大陸則以昆山、成都為製造重心。為強化供應鏈韌性，公司
近年大幅擴張越南及馬來西亞產能，並於墨西哥與捷克設有規模
龐大的工廠，以就近服務北美及歐洲市場。主要客戶方面， AI 運
算與伺服器領域包含 NVIDIA 、 AMD 、 Intel 及各大雲端服務商
(Microsoft 、 Meta 、 Google 、 Amazon) ； PC 與消費電子則涵蓋
Dell 、HP、Lenovo 及 Acer 。主要競爭對手包括鴻海 (Foxconn) 、
廣達 (Quanta) 、仁寶 (Compal) 、英業達 (Inventec) 及和碩
(Pegatron) 。

1. 四大 CSP 上修今年資本支出達 7,450 億美元  
在生成式 AI 商機快速擴張帶動下，全球雲端基礎設施投資進入新
一輪高峰。亞馬遜、 Alphabet 和微軟認為其在先前的鉅額投資已
帶動營收明顯成長 ， 同時預估未來AI 潛在商機仍持續擴大 。 其中 ，
亞馬遜、 Alphabet 和 Meta 已陸續上調 2026 全年投資金額，且四
大雲端服務供應商 (CSP) 總資本支出將上升至 7,450 億美元新高
規模。亞馬遜、微軟、 Alphabet 與 Meta 2026 年第 1、2 季分別
為 1,306 億、1,701 億美元，同時亞馬遜、 Alphabet 和 Meta 再上
修 2026 全年資本支出金額， 2026 年資本支出預估將達 7,450 億
美元。而根據 TrendForce 最新產業研究，全球主要雲端服務供應
商(CSP) 為加速建置 AI 基礎設施，資本支出預估於 2026 年將年
增 98%，2027 年再成長 50% 至 1.3 兆美元左右 ， 年增率收斂的主
要原因，除了反映高基期因素之外，部分可歸咎為鉅額資本支出
對四大 CSP 財務衝擊日益擴大。然而，在 AI Inference 、Agentic 
AI、自研 ASIC 和新一代 AI 模型持續推升算力需求的情況下，預
期整體 CSP 投資金額將續創新高紀錄，產業成長有望從原先以
GPU 擴張為主，轉為包含 AI server 、液冷散熱、先進封裝、高速
互聯、電源和記憶體等基礎設施全面升級的態勢。

圖二、 2024-2027 年全球九大 CSP 資本支出總額預估 (單位 :十億美元 )

資料來源： TrendForce 、宏遠投顧整理

2. 2026 年全球 AI 伺服器出貨量預計年增 31% 
根據 TrendForce 最新 AI server 產業研究，近期超大型 CSP 、
Tier-2 資料中心業者對 NVIDIA GB/VR 等整櫃式 AI server 方案的
採購意願明顯提高，且 Google 、AWS 新一代 ASIC 平台於 2026
下半年陸續放量，加上中系業者擴大採用本地 AI 方案以滿足雲端

需求依舊非常強勁，受惠於新客戶以及新產品線的加入，預期 AI
伺服器下半年出貨量及營收表現將優於上半年。通用型伺服器則
預期下半年出貨持平。針對第三季新舊平台交替，公司表示，新
一代 Vera Rubin 已經開始出貨，且 GB 系列下半年仍有客戶持續
採購，並未出現新舊產品迭代的空窗期。而筆電部分，公司則是
表示，由於上半年 PC 客戶提前拉貨影響，預估下半年筆電出貨
量將較上半年衰退 10~20% 。預估公司 3Q26 營收 1.16 兆， QoQ 
+29.8% ，YoY +104.7% ，毛利率 5.7% ，營利率 3.6% ，稅後淨利
163.4 億，單季稅後 EPS 5.14 元。

NVIDIA 新一代 VR 已經開始量產， CPU 機櫃、 LPU 機櫃、交換

會在下半年開始出貨。另外，網通方面，交換器 (Switch) 已開始出
貨給網通客戶，維持今年出貨量成長 10 倍以上預期，將有助於公
司產品組合的持續優化。此外，公司表示，受惠於客戶結構走向

CPU 需求強勁、營收進度超前，調高 26 年營收成長至 8 成 
展望 2H26 延續 CPU 需求強勁、MSFT Maia 200/300 及中國車用專案放量，
加上台積更多產能的支持，營收將優於 1H26 且呈季季高走勢，然 7、8 月
營收達成進度超前，因而預估 3Q26 營收季增>2 成及 26 全年營收年增近 8
成。元大預估 3Q26 營收季增 23%，毛利率略降，推估 3Q26 EPS13.76 元/
季增 19%。4Q26 為傳統入帳高峰及延續 CPU 動能，中國車用專案量產等，
營收為全年最高，毛利率有機會持平至略佳，推估 EPS16.96 元/季增 23%。 
CSP 朝 COT 模式，帶動更多 IC 設計服務委外的商機 
CSP 由傳統晶片廠統包朝向 COT(Customer Owned Tooling) 分工模式，轉
由 CSP 主 導 晶 片 架 構 與 前 端 設 計 流 程 ， 將 資 源 集 中 於 最 具 價 值 的
Architecture/RTL 前端設計，將實體設計、先進封裝、chiplet 後端設計服務
分拆外包，基於晶片複雜度提升及開發成本墊高，藉由分工達分散供應鏈風
險，對傳統 ASIC 廠商造成價值鏈瓜分，對 backend 委外需求增加反而有利
於純 設 計 服務 廠 商 。創 意布局 包括 HBM2/3/3E/4/4E 、GLink 相關 IP、
CoWoS/SOIC/DoD 解決方案，自有 IP 具客製化彈性，在 TSMC APT 生態
系的重要提升，承接底層設計機會大增，為 COT 模式下的主要受惠者之一。  
車用 AI 專案預計 2Q27~3Q27 量產，進入更強勁的成長週期 
展望 2026 年營收成長來自 CSP N3 CPU ，估計營收佔比>5 成。AI 擴大至
推論應用，CPU 需求強勁及產能獲得支援，使得 26~27 年展望較先前樂觀，

Agentic AI  帶動 CPU 價值重估、公司營運上修 
隨 AI 大型模型成熟漸漸由訓練轉向 Inference/agentic AI ，預期全球 Token 需求每三個月翻倍，其
中 ASIC 可針對客戶需求打造客製化晶片，算力使用效率較 GPU 更貼近客戶需求、較佳的性價比。
全球 AI ASIC 市場 25~28 年 CAGR 達 35~40%，估計 ASIC 滲透率將突破 3 成。Agentic AI 在於
主動任務執行，相較於過往 LLM 矩陣運算，強調 CPU/GPU/ASIC 的協同運算需求，帶動 CPU 搭
配比例提升、創意營運上修空間。 
CSP 朝 COT 模式，帶動更多 IC 設計服務委外的商機 
CSP 由傳統晶片廠統包朝向 COT(Customer Owned Tooling) 分工模式，轉由 CSP 主導晶片架構與
前端設計流程，將資源集中於最具價值的 Architecture/RTL 前端設計，將實體設計、先進封裝、
chiplet 後端設計服務分拆外包，基於晶片複雜度提升及開發成本墊高，藉由分工達分散供應鏈風險，
對傳統 ASIC 廠商造成價值鏈瓜分，對 backend 委外需求增加反而有利於純設計服務廠商。創意布
局包括 HBM2/3/3E/4/4E、GLink 相關 IP、CoWoS/SOIC/DoD 解決方案，自有 IP 具客製化彈性，
在 TSMC APT 生態系的重要提升，承接底層設計機會大增，為 COT 模式下的主要受惠者之一。 
車用 AI 專案預計 2Q27~3Q27 量產，進入更強勁的成長週期 
展望 2026 年營收成長來自 CSP N3 CPU ，估計營收佔比>5 成。AI 擴大至推論/代理型應用，CPU
需求強勁及產能獲得台積支援，使得公司 26~27 年展望較先前樂觀，並且延續 2H27~2028 年主要
成長來自車用客戶 AI 專案放量，預估 2027~28 年 AI 營收佔比>8 成。另外，CSP 轉向 COT 模式，
包括 Google、Meta 等潛在效益落在 29 年。元大最新預估 2026/27/28 EPS 54.6/113.1/163.47 元，
分別上修 7%/12%/11%，係因上修 CPU 出貨量及 Maia200/300 營收貢獻、毛利率略降 0.5 個百分
點，北美車用分別估計 27、28 年營收佔比 28%、41%，費用假設略降。

Agentic AI 將帶動 CPU 需求大幅提升 
Agentic AI 不再只是單次 prompt-response，需要反覆進行任務規劃、推理、檢查與修正。相較傳
統生成式 AI，工作流程更長、步驟更多，對系統層級調度能力要求大幅提升。 CPU 在 Agentic AI 
中主要負責 orchestration、資料前後處理，以及外部工具與資料源調用。包含  Web、Database、
API 等任務管理，協助 GPU / ASIC 專注於模型運算。隨 agent 工作流變長，CPU 與 GPU 的協同
效率將影響整體延遲、吞吐量，成為未來 AI server 架構升級重點。

圖 5：Agentic AI 的執行流程需要反覆的調用 CPU 與 GPU 的運算資源

資料來源：Semianalysis、元大投顧

解決推論延遲需提高 CPU 用量並優化演算法 
代理式 AI 涉及大量任務分解、環境切換、API 互動與外部工具調用，相關 orchestration latency 可
占總延遲約 50%-90%。搜尋網頁、分析內容、執行  Python 腳本與查詢資料庫等非模型推論任務，
多由 CPU 負責執行，因此增加 CPU 資源可直接緩解瓶頸。透過 COMB (CPU 感知微批次處理) 與 
MAS 可優化 CPU-GPU 協同演算法：COMB 將大批次任務拆分，使 CPU 與 GPU 可更同步執行，
研究顯示可提升約 1.8 倍運算效率。MAS 則依任務屬性區分 CPU-heavy 與 GPU-heavy workload，
建立彈性資源調度，避免任務壟斷整體運算資源。

圖 6：當模型執行更複雜任務需要更多 CPU

資料來源：Semianalysis、元大投顧

不同的代理 AI 場景，CPU:GPU 之比例約落在 0.8-1.4:1 
代理式 AI 的 CPU 需求取決於工作流中工具調用與資料處理比例。以網頁資料蒐集為例， DOM 
parsing、摘要生成、網路 I/O 與資料整理多由 CPU 負責，CPU 延遲占比較高。因此若應用場景偏
向資料蒐集、網頁解析與外部工具互動， CPU:GPU 最適比例將提高至約  1.4:1，以降低整體推論
瓶頸。 
Excel 自動化、 Python / Bash 腳本執行與自動生成簡報，同樣需要大量  CPU 參與。相關任務
CPU 延遲占比約 25%-65%。因此，自動化與文件生成的 agent workflow，也可將 CPU:GPU 比例
提高至約 0.8:1，以改善整體任務效率。
